outcome: cord blood brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) concentration
cohort: A total of 48 pregnant women admitted for elective caesarean section, consisting of 23 women diagnosed with depression during pregnancy and 25 without depression.
finding: Cord blood BDNF concentration was significantly lower in babies born to mothers with major depression compared to the control group.
cross-section timing: At birth, specifically during elective caesarean section.
